description.value: An American technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California, founded to commercialize Apache Kafka.
An American technology company headquartered in Mountain View, California. It was founded in 2014 to commercialize Apache Kafka, an open-source streaming platform the founders built at LinkedIn.
A data streaming platform from the original co-creators of Apache Kafka.
A data streaming platform company built by the original co-creators of Apache Kafka, helping organizations stream, connect, process, and govern real-time data for applications, analytics, and AI.
A cloud-native data streaming platform founded in 2014 by the original creators of Apache Kafka, headquartered in Mountain View, California.
A Mountain View, California company founded in 2014 to commercialize Apache Kafka.

product_description.value: Confluent Cloud, a fully managed Apache Kafka service, and Confluent Platform, a self-managed data streaming platform for on-premises deployment, with Connectors, Stream Governance, Stream Processing (Apache Flink), Tableflow, Confluent Intelligence and Streaming Agents. Also offered as Confluent Private Cloud and WarpStream.

Data Streaming with 120+ pre-built connectors and Stream Governance; Stream Processing (Apache Flink) and Tableflow; Confluent Intelligence and Streaming Agents. Deployed as Confluent Cloud, Confluent Platform, Confluent Private Cloud or WarpStream.

Confluent Cloud, Confluent Platform, Connectors, Apache Flink, Stream Governance, and Confluent Hub. In 2025 it launched Confluent Intelligence, a managed service for AI-driven anomaly detection, fraud detection, and forecasting on real-time data streams.
Services: Confluent Cloud and Confluent Platform.

Confluent Platform, an on-premises distribution of Kafka with enterprise tools, and Confluent Cloud, a fully managed cloud service for real-time data, plus Kafka Connect, ksqlDB, stream governance and WarpStream.

business_model_description.value: Consumption-based pricing ("transparent consumption-based pricing"), with a Cost Estimator that compares savings to self-managed Kafka and $400 in credits for new Confluent Cloud sign-ups.
Revenue comes mainly from the sale of subscriptions and services, and it also offers training and professional services.

customer_description.value: Organizations of all sizes, from startups to global enterprises. Named customers include SAS, Notion and GEP Worldwide.
Organizations from startups to global enterprises use the platform; named customers are SAS, Notion and GEP Worldwide.
Customers range from large enterprises to small and medium-sized businesses; typical clients include financial institutions and tech companies.
